blockers.title: The producing verdict for this successor is pinned at a digest that reproduces nowhere - the one repair v12 claims cannot be audited
blockers.location: /appliesFindingsOf/codexv11/sha256, and the same value in the v12 review-prompt
blockers.claim: appliesFindingsOf.codexv11 pins docs/coop/artifacts/distribution-core-inventory-contract.v11.review-independent.codex.json at 9c8fb1a0f8c1a2d05d3004541bbdea4e834d888bb018103f7c5cd17b8bc9af7f. basedOn.method states v12's whole purpose as 'targeted repair of Codex DCIC-V11-S1', i.e. the finding carried by that verdict.

measurement.directoryScan: I hashed every file in docs/coop/artifacts/ and the claimed digest 9c8fb1a0... matches NONE of them. It is not a mislabelled path - no artifact in the directory has that content.
measurement.gitRecoverability: The file is untracked (git ls-files --error-unmatch fails; status '??'), so no prior revision can be recovered to reconcile the two values.
measurement.allOtherPinsPass: 12 of the 13 digest pins in appliesFindingsOf reproduce EXACTLY - claude2v1HistoricalPin, claude2v4, codexv4, claude2v5, codexv5, codexv6, codexv7, codexv9, claude2v6, claude2v9, codexv10, claude2v10. codexv11 is the only failure, and it is the newest one.
measurement.dispatchCarriesItToo: The v12 review-prompt also states 'Frozen Codex v11 REJECT 9c8fb1a0...', so the unreproducible value is in both the dispatch and the subject.

blockers.why: This artifact family's entire succession discipline rests on pinned verdict digests: CLAUDE-V3-ADV-4 and CLAUDE-V5-S2 were raised and repaired precisely so that 'honestyRepairsFromV1 retain the verdict that produced them', and claude2v1HistoricalPin exists for that reason. Here the CURRENT generation's producing verdict does not reproduce. I cannot verify that DCIC-V11-S1 says what basedOn.method and honestyRepairsFromV11 report it says, nor that DCIC-V11-A1 is characterised correctly, nor that the codexv11 shouldFix/advisories lists are accurate. The single claimed repair of this version is therefore unauditable at its own recorded provenance.
blockers.scopeOfWhatIAmAsserting: I did NOT open the Codex v11 file - I only hashed it. I assert nothing about its contents, only that the pinned digest does not reproduce against the bytes at the pinned path and matches no file in the directory.
blockers.notableTiming: Not part of the finding, but relevant to diagnosis: the subject was written at 01:38:13 and the Codex v11 review file at 01:38:21, eight seconds LATER. A pin taken against a pre-flush draft that was subsequently rewritten would produce exactly this signature. That is a hypothesis, not a measurement.
blockers.fix: Re-measure the frozen Codex v11 verdict and correct /appliesFindingsOf/codexv11/sha256 (and the dispatch line) to the reproducing value; or, if 9c8fb1a0... is the authoritative frozen artifact, restore that file so the path and digest agree. Either way the pin and the bytes must reconcile before the repair claim can be audited.

Live remasurement does not close that clause.' honestyRepairsFromV11[0]: 'CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 remains partially folded; the remaining ... clause is booked in notFoldedThisSuccessor.'
measurement.whatTheBytesSay: v12 basedOn.method reads: '... /date is on this roster and is unchanged. Every path neither the roster nor succession metadata names is unchanged from v11.' The required substring is PRESENT.
measurement.predecessorComparison: v11's method said only '/date is on this roster.' - I tested the substring and it is absent there. So v12 ADDED the exact clause the ledger says is still missing.
measurement.conditionIsAlsoTrue: /date is 2026-08-15 in both v11 and v12, so the 'and is unchanged' disclosure is accurate, not merely present.
measurement.otherHalfAlreadyClosed: CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1's first half (the universal unchanged-outside-roster sentence) is present and was folded at v10. With the date clause now present, BOTH halves are satisfied and ADV-1 is fully folded at v12.

shouldFix.why: This is the same defect class the family has been iterating on since v6, only inverted. v6/v7 claimed a fold that the bytes had not made; v12 denies a fold that its own bytes have made. The dispatch's claimed repair - 'CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 remaining date-clause booked; honesty and notFolded agree' - is technically true and substantively misleading: the two ledger fields do agree with each other, and both now disagree with basedOn.method. A reader auditing the outstanding list is told to look for a clause that is already there.
shouldFix.severityReasoning: Graded SHOULD-FIX for consistency with how this family has graded every prior fold-accounting error (CLAUDE-V5-S3, CLAUDE-V6-S1, CLAUDE-V9-S2, CLAUDE-V10-S1, and my own CLAUDE-V11-S1). It corrupts the ledger, not the contract's substance.
shouldFix.fix: Move CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 out of notFoldedThisSuccessor and record it as fully folded at v12 in honestyRepairsFromV11, noting that the date clause was added by this successor. If the intent was to record a standing obligation that future successors keep the clause, put that in the roster/method note rather than in the not-folded list.

observations.title: A completed Claude v11 verdict exists and is absent from the ledger - but it postdates the subject, so this is NOT charged against v12
observations.detail: docs/coop/artifacts/distribution-core-inventory-contract.v11.review-independent.claude2.json exists, reviews v11 at the correct path, is dated 2026-08-15 and carries verdict REJECT with one SHOULD-FIX (CLAUDE-V11-S1). appliesFindingsOf has no claude2v11 entry, and the string 'CLAUDE-V11' appears nowhere in v12.
observations.whyNotAFinding: Filesystem timestamps show the subject was written at 01:38:13 and that verdict at 01:39:30 - 77 seconds later. Stronger still: I watched it finish. At my first directory listing it was 9994 bytes at mode 0644; by the time I measured it, it was 21691 bytes; it was frozen to 0444 at ctime 01:40:05 while this review was in progress, content settling at 405bade035520bd4dd3e42b509db43f92ebcfa89dea23906bbf6374d8a34a6b8. It was still being authored when v12 was sealed. v12 could not have pinned it, and the dispatch names only the Codex v11 verdict as input. Charging this to v12 would be unfair.
observations.whyTheCoordinatorStillNeedsIt: CLAUDE-V11-S1 raised exactly the missing '/date ... and is unchanged' clause that v12 in fact added. So v12 substantively repairs a Claude finding it never records, while crediting only Codex. When v13 is authored, claude2v11 should be pinned and CLAUDE-V11-S1 booked - and, per CLAUDE-V12-S1 above, booked as FOLDED. Note also the family's own convention of recording absent lanes explicitly ('Codex did not review v1').

limitsOfThisReview: I did not open the current v12 Codex reviewer, per instruction.

I did not open the v11 Codex verdict either - I hashed it only, to test the subject's pin. Consequently CLAUDE-V12-B1 reports a digest mismatch and nothing about that file's contents. Whether DCIC-V11-S1 and DCIC-V11-A1 are correctly characterised in honestyRepairsFromV11 remains unverifiable from my side until the pin reconciles; that verification is itself blocked by B1.
Because the codexv11 pin does not reproduce, my clean findings on the substance of v12 should not be read as clearing the succession record for this generation.
summary: The contract's substance is untouched by this generation and holds up: the DR-101 row-verbatim and the 30-line file 02 carry are byte-exact, the stale L38-41 sentence is named rather than carried, the language and notarization reservations stand, no DR-106 storage is smuggled into the default install, and nothing mints a D-096 (A) grant or a SATISFIED token. The roster is exact with a pure-append reviewGuidance. Two defects stop it. First, and blocking: the Codex v11 verdict - the producing verdict for this successor's only claimed repair - is pinned at 9c8fb1a0..., but the file at that path hashes to e5230352..., and the claimed digest matches no file anywhere in the artifacts directory. Twelve of the other thirteen pins reproduce exactly, so this is a specific custody break rather than a systemic pinning problem, and because the file is untracked no revision can be recovered to reconcile it. I hashed that file without opening it, so I assert only the mismatch, not its contents. Second: v12 added the '/date is on this roster and is unchanged' clause to basedOn.method - the exact remaining half of CLAUDE-V6-ADV-1 - while its ledger continues to book that clause as outstanding. The dispatch's 'honesty and notFolded agree' is true of the two fields and false of the bytes they describe. Separately, a completed Claude v11 verdict carrying CLAUDE-V11-S1 exists and is absent from the ledger; it postdates the subject by 77 seconds and was in fact still being written and then frozen during this review, so I did not charge it to v12 - but v13 should pin it at 405bade0..., and should book ADV-1 as folded.
